source_title: Jiang Xueqin: The West's Civilizational Collapse
summary: This Glenn Diesen interview is already partly absorbed into the public lens: Jiang uses energy, openness, and cohesion as a civilizational scorecard, turns elite overproduction and sanctions repetition into domestic-war and bureaucracy anchors, and adds dated forecast pressure around Pax Judaica, U.S.-China rapprochement, Ukraine/Odessa, AI-bubble collapse, and Western rapid decline.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The public read already links Jiang's claim that the second Trump administration is a civil war between rival oligarchic blocs to the Proximity Games anchor.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The active mechanism is not generic Trump commentary; it is elite overproduction turning a visible party fight into a nearer domestic hierarchy struggle.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The public read already links the reality-is-not-discussed and sanctions-repeat-because-sanctions-were-used-before marks to the Bureaucracy anchor.

new_lens_seeds.title: Pax Judaica As Capital Platform
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A successor order can be imagined less as a national virtue story than as an investment platform: transnational capital separates the state host from the empire project, then asks where enforcement, reconstruction, intelligence, infrastructure, and growth make money safest.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This source gives the clean distinction between Israel the nation-state and Pax Judaica as a capital project, while later November 30, January, March, and April sources add enforcement, eschatology, surveillance, and war-route layers. The mechanism is real pressure but still overlaps Power As Alchemy, Eschatology, Strategy, Secret Society, Platform Infrastructure, and Prediction.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Do not create a standalone Pax Judaica page from this source alone; first compare the capital-platform, sacred-script, surveillance-infrastructure, and material-route versions across the existing impact records.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-11-24, this interview supplies an earlier public formulation of Pax Judaica as civilizational ascent and capital platform before the 2025-11-30 CapitalCosm source now public on Power As Alchemy and before the January-March 2026 eschatological-war versions.

The U.S.-China rapprochement claim sits between earlier September and October 2025 rapprochement forecasts and later December/March recurrences; it should be compared as one forecast family, not promoted as a single isolated call.
